recaps.text: Stephen Bunting beat Max Hopp 6-5 in round one of the Players Championship Finals, where Gerwyn Price and top seed Wessel Nijman both lost.
Rangers lost 2-1 at the Blackhawks and the Knicks lost 108-105 to the Heat at Madison Square Garden.
